rule: At least two independent biologically compatible study units
All12 DFU_vs_DFS and DFU_vs_NFS both have BH FDR below 0.05
All12 separate-comparator logFC values have the same nonzero direction
All12 and n11 separate-comparator logFC values retain one common nonzero direction
Eligibility is determined by separate comparators and never by the pooled DFS/NFS contrast
All12 remains primary and n11 remains sensitivity only
No meta-analysis or leave-one-study-out estimate is computed with fewer than two independent studies
Cross-study pathway robustness requires at least two independent compatible studies and a prospectively locked pathway collection
